limits: Grenache, Grenache Blanc and Grenache Gris together: 30 to 60%

blurb.text: A southern Rhône appellation that makes only rosé, in the commune of Tavel across the river from Châteauneuf-du-Pape. Wines must reach. Allowed grapes include Grenache, Cinsault, Syrah, Mourvèdre and Clairette.
